Q1: Prednisolone exhibits several recognized hazards, classified as Tier 1 by the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, and reproductive hazards (CMR), environmental hazards (ENV), oral hazards (ORL), and organ and systemic hazards (OGN). Inhalation hazards (IHL) are recognized at Tier 2, indicating potential hazards beyond GHS classifications, while endocrine disruption hazards (EDC) are considered low to moderate at Tier 3. Notably, data for dermal and eye hazards (SKN) are currently deficient, warranting a precautionary approach.
